name: AppFolio
description: AppFolio Property Manager is real-estate operations software for managing properties, units, residents, owners, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, reporting and third-party proptech integrations.
agentUseSummary: AppFolio is visible as a provider-review preview. Relay will not collect credentials or expose agent actions until AppFolio accepts Relay into its Stack partner program and supplies the approved production authentication, endpoint, scope, limit and customer-authorization contract.

capabilities.label: Access approved property-management data
capabilities.description: After AppFolio approves and certifies Relay, expose only typed, bounded capabilities from the exact production contract and customer-authorized portfolio.

blocked.label: Connect before AppFolio approval
blocked.description: Relay has not been accepted, contracted, security-reviewed or certified as an AppFolio Stack integration partner.

blocked.label: Collect unapproved AppFolio credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not request customer passwords, session material, sandbox credentials or partner credentials outside AppFolio's approved integration process.

blocked.label: Access sensitive property data before review
blocked.description: Resident, applicant, owner, vendor, bank, accounting, collections, ledger, payment, location, lease and maintenance data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change AppFolio before contract review
blocked.description: Bills, charges, owners, vendors, leads, showings, work orders, units, attachments and every other mutation remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Run AppFolio actions before certification
blocked.description: No raw or typed API action is callable until AppFolio supplies and certifies Relay's production authorization and endpoint contract.

approvalProfiles.label: AppFolio partner review required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable until AppFolio approves, contracts, security-reviews and certifies Relay as a Stack integration partner.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable before AppFolio partner approval and production certification.
No Hermes tools are callable before AppFolio partner approval and production certification.

providerSetup.blocker: AppFolio's public API catalog identifies many read and write resource families, but production integration is available through the AppFolio Stack partner program. The official path requires an application, AppFolio review, a security compliance questionnaire, signed terms, provider-issued developer tools and sandbox access, development and testing, final review and certification. Public pages do not supply Relay a self-service production authentication, tenant authorization, endpoint schema, rate-limit or distribution contract.
providerSetup.nextAction: Apply to the AppFolio Stack integration partner program in the separate provider-console task. Complete legal and security review, obtain the sandbox and full OpenAPI/authentication contract, confirm customer authorization, tenant binding, credential lifecycle, limits, webhooks and permitted fields, then implement and certify only typed, bounded and redacted tools before live consent testing.

evidence.supports: AppFolio's official partner page requires application review, a security compliance questionnaire, final approval and signature, development and testing, and final review before an integration is published; approved partners receive developer tools and a sandbox.

The official public API catalog lists broad read and write families including properties, units, tenants, owners, applicants, leads, bank accounts, bills, charges, ledgers, vendors, work orders, attachments and community-association records, but does not publish a self-service production authentication or endpoint contract.
AppFolio engineering describes Stack as a partner integration platform using OpenAPI contracts and partner-specific sandboxes with representative sample data before customer production use.
AppFolio describes Stack as a marketplace of reviewed and certified third-party integrations for property-management customers rather than an unrestricted customer-key integration surface.

AppFolio's privacy notice covers real-estate business-customer data and sensitive personal, account, device, financial, screening and service information, supporting critical handling and field-level review before access.
